rows.label: FAST TIME SCALE
rows.clue: (simulation) the time scale used in data processing when the time-scale factor is less than one

rows.label: CHECKOUT TIME
rows.clue: The latest time for vacating a hotel room

rows.label: CYCLE
rows.clue: An interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs

rows.label: ADOLESCENCE
rows.clue: The time period between the beginning of puberty and adulthood

rows.label: MILES PER HOUR
rows.clue: The ratio of the distance traveled (in miles) to the time spent traveling (in hours)

rows.label: SPLIT RUN
rows.clue: A print run of a newspaper during which some articles or advertisements are changed to produce a different edition

rows.label: INTERIM
rows.clue: The time between one event, process, or period and another

rows.label: SMALL HOURS
rows.clue: The hours just after midnight

rows.label: TRIENNIAL
rows.clue: The 300th anniversary (or the celebration of it)

rows.label: MIDWINTER
rows.clue: The middle of winter

rows.label: DOSE RATE
rows.clue: The quantity of radiation absorbed per unit time

rows.label: GIRLHOOD
rows.clue: The childhood of a girl

rows.label: WORK DAY
rows.clue: A day on which work is done

rows.label: SAMPLING RATE
rows.clue: (telecommunication) the frequency of sampling per unit time

rows.label: DAYTIME
rows.clue: The time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside

rows.label: LUNAR YEAR
rows.clue: A period of 12 lunar months

rows.label: MEALTIME
rows.clue: The hour at which a meal is habitually or customarily eaten

rows.label: WINTER
rows.clue: The coldest season of the year

rows.label: TOMORROW
rows.clue: The day after today

rows.label: FULL TERM
rows.clue: The end of gestation or point at which birth is imminent

rows.label: SECOND PERIOD
rows.clue: The second division into which the play of a game is divided

rows.label: PRESIDENCY
rows.clue: The tenure of a president

rows.label: EPISCOPATE
rows.clue: The term of office of a bishop

rows.label: SABBATICAL
rows.clue: A leave usually taken every seventh year

rows.label: UNIVERSAL TIME
rows.clue: The local time at the 0 meridian passing through Greenwich, England

rows.label: CULMINATION
rows.clue: A final climactic stage

rows.label: SHOW TIME
rows.clue: The point in time at which an entertainment (a movie or television show etc.) is scheduled to begin

rows.label: AFTERNOON
rows.clue: The part of the day between noon and evening

rows.label: PRESS RUN
rows.clue: The period that presses run to produce an issue of a newspaper

rows.label: TEST PERIOD
rows.clue: A period of time during which someone or something is tested

rows.label: HOCKEY SEASON
rows.clue: The season when hockey is played

rows.label: STINT
rows.clue: An unbroken period of time during which you do something

rows.label: AIRSPEED
rows.clue: The speed of an aircraft relative to the air in which it is flying
